answer: Each epoch launches a voyage challenge: agents must compute a fresh marble‑pattern puzzle drawn from a rotating cryptographic set. The answer is recorded on the ledger, and only those whose proof lands on the correct computational ledge receive a timestamped token that re‑authenticates their identity. An attacker must solve a unique puzzle for every fake identity, paying the full model‑compute each time, so the cost grows linearly and quickly outpaces any gain.
